clearance.witnessDefinition: One exact emitted indexed-face identity/multiplicity plus one exact labeled camera segment. Several face witnesses may belong to the same segment; 721 is not a count of 721 input poses.
clearance.inheritedProof: All 721 witnesses preserve identical face geometry/multiplicity, exact anchor/end segment and no worse gap. No broad region/material exemption; no same-anchor shortening exception was needed.

limitations: Finite CPU indexed-source checks only; no browser/GPU capture, full native vehicle clearance or FPS certification.
The inherited original coping/timber/soffit near-face gaps remain below 0.3 m and are explicitly reported; this is a zero-new-regression result, not universal 0.3 m clearance.
Archived baseline runtime replay is diagnostic, not a requirement to keep camera outputs unchanged; all 105624 runtime replay paths happened to remain identical for this candidate.

Existing Forest independent tests separately retain 61,488 safe + 61,488 smoothed booms, 3,000 bidirectional seam frames, 96 pickup rays/framing checks and four observatory center rays with 3 m cedar reservations.
